# SpikeBasedSensoryMotorLoop

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A closed-loop control architecture where sensory spikes directly trigger motor commands without intermediate conventional computation, mimicking biological reflex arcs. Reduces reaction time and energy overhead in robotic systems, aligning with iNEST's goal of in-network neuromorphic processing.
